jobs_results.title: Senior Qa Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Senior Qa Engineer Madrid, Community of Madrid

Senior Qa Engineer

Madrid

Madrid, Community of Madrid, ES

Senior QA Engineer– Marketing & SalesDo you want to make an impact every day by keeping people safe - and by bringing them a sense of security and peace of mind? Interested in being part of a dedicated, passionate team that believes that security is a human right? Looking to join a company where innovation and technology are at the heart of its solutions? Join us today!Present in more than 17 countries across Europe and Latin America, Verisure Securitas Direct is a leader specializing in developing products and services in the home security sector. We are an award-winning ‘Internet of Things company, having amassed a ton of experience and expertise for over more than 30 years. Unlike many competitors, we keep most work in-house to guarantee premium quality every step of the way. Our office in Madrid is a top R&D Center in the connected smart home market. Here we create and... develop services and products for home security and home automation. We are looking for people who can make a tangible positive impact in delivering breakthrough innovation in Research & Development to transform and add value, not only to our Company but the industry itself. Main ResponsibilitiesWe are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who set up and lead the QA strategy for the Marketing and Sales domains in our 17 Countries. Define and implement the test strategy of the Global Marketing and Sales IT department. Align this implementation and tools used with the QA discipline in the company. Collaborate with the discipline with create the best in class QA processes in the company. Define the way of working regarding QA aligned with the product owner, technical lead and scrum master. Lead the execution of this QA strategy and implementation of this way of working in each of the scrum teams aligned with the priorities and situation of each project. Manage performance of the QA test together with the product owners and technical leads of each team (6-7 people). Work together with the Service/Maintenance team, QA team and developers to drive to 0 the bugs in production. Implement a continuous improvement mindset within the QA team and other members of the company with the objective of maximize the quality in production. Improve testing processes like implementation of E2E scenarios which covers critical processes. Define and lead the implementation of the testing automation strategy. Lead the implementation of the device farm project and promote the usage in the company. Build reports to understand the QA situation within the teams. Report status of implementation of the strategy to middle and senior management. Competencies Strategic mindset and leadership skills to lead a team and the implementation of the strategy. 5+ years’ experience leading QA teams10+ years’ experience in testingExperience with testing plugin in JIRA, Confluence. Experience with devices farm tools (Google, AWS, Saculelabs)Experience with testing automation tools (selenium, webdriver. Io, apium)Experience working in international environmentExperience managing senior management stakeholdersFunctional understanding of the marketing and sales businessExperience with Agile Methodologies/lean and tools: JIRA, Confluence, etc. Ability to clearly communicate with peers, manager and senior managersAbility to function with new technologiesRequirementsEducation:Master/ B. A in Computer Engineer or TelecommunicationsEnglish B2Other Competencies:Service culture, continuous improvement mindsetCritical thinking and problem solving abilities to address complex issues involving data movement and data replicationProactive and dynamic personMust be a self-starter as well as a good team player. Good communication skills. Leadership skills to help technical lead with the team motivation to learn new methodologies. We Offer Passion for our PeopleWe believe that we make a difference every day. To do that, we need committed and engaged employees. Our people are accountable for delivering world-class service and they are passionate about making the world a safer and more secure place. Our teams operate with integrity and respect for one another fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit. We are building a high-performance organization through investing in our people with great development and growth opportunities. We also offer hybrid working model. Passion for InnovationWe are a growth company. Our continuous investment in innovation has led to consistent top and bottom-line growth. The more we grow, the safer the world becomes. Our InvestorsWe are owned by a leading private equity firm: Hellman & Friedman. Our sponsor has invested in our innovation pipeline and in our organization to fuel our accelerated growth and play a leading role in the industry. At Hexa Consulting we want to spread transparency and enable diverse tech careers. Based in Portugal, we can answer the increasing demand in the IT sector.

Our mission is to build strong relationships, be a leading partner through a differentiated approach in IT consulting and contribute to the professional and personal development of our team.

We work with Nearshore projects, TM & Project Development, Service Management and Tech Academies.

Responsibilities:
• Perform functional, compatibility, and performance testing on applications for STB platforms.
• Create and execute detailed test cases to ensure the quality and usability of products.
• Identify, document, and report bugs and quality issues clearly and concisely.

Requirements:
• Fluency in both Spanish and English, both oral and written.
• Minimum of 2 years of proven experience as a QA in software development.
• Practical experience with Set-Top Box (STB) tools and testing in related environments.
• Strong analytical and... problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team.

What do we offer?
• B2B contract
• Health insurance
• Career development
• Access to Training

If you’re living in Portugal or in the EU, and are looking for the right opportunity, don’t waste your time. Be part of this amazing journey!

It’s never just business, we always make it personal

jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
Oportunidad de empleo: QA Tester

Empresa

El Cliente es una empresa de servicios financieros con formato híbrido en Madrid, especializada en ofrecer soluciones innovadoras y eficientes. Nos destacamos por nuestra dedicación y compromiso en brindar a nuestros clientes la mejor experiencia posible.

Descripción del puesto

Estamos buscando un QA Tester altamente capacitado para unirse a nuestro equipo. Como QA Tester, serás responsable de garantizar la calidad y el rendimiento de nuestros productos y sistemas. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con los equipos de desarrollo y los analistas de negocio para identificar y solucionar cualquier problema en nuestros software y aplicaciones.

Requisitos
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años como QA Tester en entornos financieros o similares.
• Sólidos conocimientos en técnicas de pruebas manuales.
• Amplio dominio de herramientas de gestión de proyectos como JIRA .
• Excelente nivel de inglés (tanto escrito como hablado).
• Capacidad para trabajar... en equipo y comunicarse eficazmente.
• Orientado/a a los detalles y con excelentes habilidades analíticas.
• Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para adaptarse a entornos cambiantes.
Responsabilidades
• Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba manuales para garantizar la calidad de los productos y sistemas.
• Realizar el seguimiento y la resolución de problemas en colaboración con los equipos de desarrollo.
• Participar en la identificación y mitigación de riesgos relacionados con la calidad y el rendimiento.
• Colaborar estrechamente con los analistas de negocio para comprender los requisitos y objetivos del cliente.
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el equipo de desarrollo para proporcionar retroalimentación constante sobre la calidad del software y las posibles mejoras.
• Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre las últimas tendencias y mejores prácticas en pruebas de software.
Beneficios
• Salario competitivo y paquete de beneficios atractivo.
• Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional en un entorno dinámico.
• Trabajar junto a un equipo altamente calificado y colaborativo.
• Participar en proyectos innovadores y desafiantes.
Cómo aplicar

Si cumples con los requisitos y estás interesado/a en formar parte de nuestro equipo como QA Tester, envíanos tu currículum. Agradecemos de antemano a todos los candidatos/as su interés, sin embargo, solo contactaremos a aquellos que sean seleccionados para una entrevista.

¡Esperamos recibir tu solicitud y poder conocerte!

Requisitos:
• Experiencia realizando pruebas manuales
• Nivel de inglés B2 o superior
• Conocimiento SQL

jobs_results.title: Localization QA Tester (Russian)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2005, the 2K label includes some of the most talented game development studios in the world today including: Firaxis Games, Visual Concepts, Hangar 13, 2K Czech and Cat Daddy Games. Our world-class team of engineers, developers, graphic artists and publishing professionals are stewards of a growing library of critically-acclaimed franchises such as Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, The Darkness, Mafia, NBA 2K, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. 2K is headquartered in Novato, California and is a wholly owned label of Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTWO).

2K develops and publishes interactive entertainment globally for console systems, handheld gaming systems and personal computers, including smartphones and tablets, which are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including shooters, action, role-playing, strategy... sports, casual, and family entertainment.

Our vision at 2K is to create a diverse and inclusion environment to “Come as You are and Feel Equipped to do Your Best Work!” We are dedicated to promoting diversity, multiculturalism, and equality in all that we do. Our communities are focused on increased access and personal growth, and their greatness depends on a diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, national origin, and perspective. We're an equal opportunity employer, and we're excited to build the future of co-living with the world's most hardworking and passionate people.

What We Need

We are looking for someone who can test video game titles on various consoles, PC’s and handhelds to ensure flawless game play by thoroughly checking the software for errors and entering them into the testing database. The Localization QA Tester reports to the Localization QA Lead and/or Associate Lead.

What You Will Do
• Find and report issues in the game, or through testing directly in the text database.
• Provide the correct translation, and where applicable fix directly via text database
• Provide context for foreign language defects
• Identify defects, follow test plans, and verify fixes
• Enter clear and concise bugs into bug tracking database
• Verify all printed materials related to software in test
• Work closely with other Localization QA team members

Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit
• Must be fluent, reading/writing, in Russian
• Must be able to communicate effectively in English, in both written and oral forms
• Technically proficient with PC’s, gaming consoles and related hardware
• Computer literacy, specifically with Windows, MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Google Suite and databases
• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills
• Reliable with the ability to work in a team environment
• Attention to detail
• Passion for video games
• Be a positive role model, in terms of both work performance and attitude

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor diploma or equivalent
• Experience as a Localization QA Tester and/or Translator is a plus
• Preferable 0-2 years of QA experience

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

We're an equal opportunity employer, and we're excited to build the future of co-living with the world's most hardworking and passionate people.

What We Need

We are looking for someone who can test video game titles on various consoles, PC’s and handhelds to ensure flawless game play by thoroughly checking the software for errors and entering them into the testing database. The Localization QA Tester reports to the Localization QA Lead and/or Associate Lead.

What You Will Do
• Find and report issues in the game, or through testing directly in the text database.
• Provide the correct translation, and where applicable fix directly via text database
• Provide context for foreign language defects
• Identify defects, follow test plans, and verify fixes
• Enter clear and concise bugs into bug tracking database
• Verify all printed materials related to software in test
• Work closely with other Localization QA team members

Who We Think Will Be A Great Fit
• Must be fluent, reading/writing, in Russian
• Must be able to communicate effectively in English, in both written and oral forms
• Technically proficient with PC’s, gaming consoles and related hardware
• Computer literacy, specifically with Windows, MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Google Suite and databases
• Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills
• Reliable with the ability to work in a team environment
• Attention to detail
• Passion for video games
• Be a positive role model, in terms of both work performance and attitude

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor diploma or equivalent
• Experience as a Localization QA Tester and/or Translator is a plus
• Preferable 0-2 years of QA experience

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Please note that 2K Games and its studios never uses instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, only use 2K.com accounts.

jobs_results.title: QA/tester Automatización Pruebas
jobs_results.description:
**Seguimos buscando talento y nos encantaría que te unieras a nuestro equipo**

Para que nos conozcas algo mejor, UST es una multinacional norteamericana certificada como Top Employer con más de 30.000 empleados a nível global y con presencia en más de 30 países. Somos líderes en servicios de tecnología digital y proporcionamos soluciones tecnológicas de gran alcance a grandes compañías.
• *¿Qué buscamos?**

Para nuestro equipo de Servicios de Software de la unidad de Operaciones de Ciberseguridad estamos buscando un QA con experiência en automatización de pruebas.

El objetivo de este puesto es probar el software desarrollado en nuestra plataforma Managed Security Services & automation que proporciona gestión de los datos y procesos de seguridad de nuestros clientes.
• *Colaboración 100% remota desde cualquier provincia de España.**
• *Funciones**
- Participar en procedimientos de pruebas de software, como definición, automatización y ejecución de pruebas.
- Ayudar a impulsar la... definición de diferentes marcos y tecnologías para probar de la manera más eficiente posible las nuevas características.
- Escribir pruebas limpias y estables para asegurar su integración en el ciclo completo de pruebas y desarrollo.
- Trabajar en colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares utilizando metodologías ágiles.
- Apoyar y realizar otras actividades (pruebas unitarias y de rendimiento y Devops) cuando lo requiera el contexto.
• *Requisito indispensable**:

- Al menos 4 años de experiência demostrable en entornos de pruebas ágiles.
- Licenciatura en Informática (grado, superior o técnico), Telecomunicaciones o afines.
- Experiência trabajando con Python y Selenium.
- Experiência con JIRA o herramientas similares.
- Conocimientos de Bases de Datos.
- Experiência en metodologías de testing.
- Conocimientos de Bug reporting.
- Experiência con metodología Agile.
- Familiaridad con las mejores prácticas de codificación: integración continua, despliegue continuo, revisiones de código y herramientas relacionadas (Jenkins, Github, etc.).
• *Deseable y valorable: Poseer Certificado de discapacidad.**
• *¿Qué te ofrecemos?**
- 23 días laborables de vacaciones y el 24 y 31 de diciembre.
- Numerosos beneficios sociales (seguro médico, ayuda al teletrabajo, seguro de vida y seguro de accidentes).
- Programa de Retribución Flexible (tarjeta comida, cheques guardería, tarjeta transporte, clases de inglés online, seguro médico para tu familia ).
- Acceso gratuito a varias plataformas de formación.
- Estabilidad y carrera profesional.
- Tenemos implantado un plan de compensación de referencias internas.
- Posibilidad de elección de percibir tu salario en 12 o 14 pagas.
- Medidas de conciliación (horario flexible, teletrabajo, asesoramiento de especialistas (psicólogo, nutricionista, entrenador personal), jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano según proyecto).
- Plataforma UST Club descuentos y descuentos en gimnasios.
• *Si quieres conocer más, no dudes en inscribirte y nos pondremos en contacto contigo para ampliarte información de la posición Te estamos esperando
